title: THE REST OF THE LEVITES RECEIVE THEIR SHARE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The rest of Kohath's descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of the tribes of Ephraim, Dan and half of Manasseh. The descendants of Gershon were allotted thirteen towns from the clans of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan. The descendants of Merari, according to their clans, received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun. — Josh 21:5-7 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Kohath, Gershon and Merari — three branches of the Levite family — each receive their allotment. Every clan is named. Every group is counted. Not one is overlooked. The towns are drawn from tribes in the north, south, east and west, so that the Levites truly reach every part of the land.

It would be easy to skim past a list like this. But God does not deal in vague generalities. He knows the families, the clans, the numbers. He is a God of detail, and the detail here tells us that He forgets no one who serves Him.

This careful record is quietly reassuring. If God took such care to provide a home for each branch of one tribe, how much more does He know and provide for each of His children today? Jesus tells us that our Father knows even the number of hairs on our heads (Luke 12:7). You are not lost in a crowd before God. He knows your name, your family, your situation.

The same faithful God who settled every Levite clan in its place is arranging the details of your life with the same care.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you believe God knows the small details of your life?
2. When you feel overlooked, how does God's attention to each clan encourage you?
3. Is there a detail you can entrust to your Father today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You forget no one and overlook no detail. When I feel unseen, remind me that You know my name and hold my life in Your hands. Amen.
